insight.headline: Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their code to handle the new error response. They should ensure that metafields are properly set up for filtering before querying them. This change affects any app using the GraphQL Admin API to query metafields. Developers should review their code and test it with the new API version to avoid errors.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice improved accuracy in search results and fewer errors when using apps that query metafields.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy and reliability of metafield queries, which is essential for many Shopify apps. It also helps developers catch and fix errors earlier, reducing the risk of incorrect results.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, instead of silently returning incorrect results, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Apps can now subscribe to events for various topics, including metafield changes, using the Events API.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, making it easier to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview is now available, providing early access to new inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI has been updated to fix a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen package has been updated to add non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags to hydrogen link.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include a unique name for each app, reducing merchant confusion.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API @inContext directive now supports a channelId argument, allowing for specific sales channel context to be applied to queries.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle fields.

updates.title: POS UI Extensions 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components
updates.summary: The POS UI Extensions API now includes discount allocations to bundle components, starting with version 2026-07.

recap.headline: Enhanced GraphQL Admin API, expanded event triggers, and improved Liquid templates

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Updates
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries in API version 2026-10, ensuring more accurate results. This change affects queries that filter by metafields not set up for filtering.

themes.title: Event Triggers and Liquid Templates
themes.detail: New event triggers are available for various topics, including metafield changes on products, orders, customers, collections, and locations. Additionally, Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page development.

themes.title: App Development and Analytics
themes.detail: App developers can leverage full-stack capabilities to power merchant-facing analytics, streamlining the process of building and maintaining analytics tools.

actions.text: Update GraphQL Admin API queries to handle error responses for invalid metafield filters
Explore new event triggers for metafield changes and other topics
Evaluate the use of Liquid templates with blocks and partials for theme development
